title: Apply for a Class 3 (Miscellaneous) vehicle access permit
summary: This page provides information on applying for a Class 3 (Miscellaneous) vehicle access permit if your heavy vehicle does not comply with specific mass, dimension, or operating requirements.
intro:
If your heavy vehicle does not comply with mass, dimension or operating requirements set out in a gazette notice, you'll need to apply for a Class 3 (Miscellaneous) access permit.

You may also require the Class 3 permit if you're operating under a jurisdictional permit-based scheme.

You apply for the permit via the National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NHVR) portal, NHVR Go.

The NHVR permit applies to travel throughout Australia, with the exception of Western Australia and the Northern Territory, where you'll need to apply directly to the relevant state or territory road transport authority.

Visit the Class 3 (Miscellaneous) vehicle access permit on the NHVR website for detailed information.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a Class 3 (Miscellaneous) vehicle access permit?
faqs.a: You apply for the permit via the National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NHVR) portal, NHVR Go.

faqs.q: Does the NHVR permit cover all of Australia?
faqs.a: The NHVR permit applies to travel throughout Australia, but you must apply directly to the relevant state or territory road transport authority if you are in Western Australia or the Northern Territory.

faqs.q: Where can I find detailed information about the Class 3 (Miscellaneous) vehicle access permit?
faqs.a: Visit the Class 3 (Miscellaneous) vehicle access permit page on the NHVR website for detailed information.
